# Initial Dataframes

```{r}
#Gets the raw text first, checks and removes any encoding problems, try to fix them


raw_lines <- readLines(Pad_df, warn=FALSE)
bad<- !validUTF8(raw_lines) #Checks for valid UTF-8 text
raw_lines[bad] <- iconv(raw_lines[bad],"latin1","UTF-8") #Converts latin1 text (most common) to UTF-8 text
raw_lines <- sub("^\ufeff","",raw_lines) #Removes common BOM from rawlines

#Number of columns
n_cols <- max(count.fields(textConnection(raw_lines),sep=",",quote="\"", blank.lines.skip = FALSE),na.rm=TRUE)

raw<- read.csv(text=raw_lines, header= FALSE,colClasses = "character",col.names = paste0("V",seq_len(n_cols)),fill=TRUE,blank.lines.skip = FALSE,na.strings=character(0))
raw[is.na(raw)]<- ""
raw[] <- lapply(raw,trimws)

#Pulls wavelength label
extract_block <-function(raw,wavelength, header_key="Reading"){
  is_blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | x=="" #Checks for blank
  
  #Gets the wavelength and header rows
  wl_rows <- which(grepl(wavelength,raw[[1]],ignore.case=TRUE))
  hdr_rows <- which(apply(raw,1,function(r) any(tolower(r)==tolower(header_key))))
  
  #Pairs each wavelength label with the next reading header
  next_hdr <- sapply(wl_rows,function(r){
    header <- hdr_rows[hdr_rows >=r]
    if(length(header)) header[1] else NA
  })
  ok <- !is.na(next_hdr)
  if(!any(ok)) stop("No '",header_key,"' header found after '", wavelength,"'.")
  hdr_row<- next_hdr[ok][which.min((next_hdr-wl_rows)[ok])]
  
  #Columns from the 'Reading' cell after the first blank header cell
  hdr<-unlist(raw[hdr_row, ], use.names=FALSE) #Gets header
  first_col <-which(tolower(hdr) == tolower(header_key))[1] #Get first column
  gaps <- which(is_blank(hdr) & seq_along(hdr) > first_col) #Looks for gaps
  last_col <- if(length(gaps)) gaps[1] -1 else length(hdr) #Gets last column before blank
  cols<- first_col:last_col #Gets all columns
  
  #Runs from below the header down to the first blank row that is fully blank
  if(hdr_row == nrow(raw)) stop("'",wavelength,"' block has a header but no data.")
  body<- raw[(hdr_row +1):nrow(raw),cols,drop=FALSE]
  stop_at<- which(apply(body,1,function(r) all(is_blank(r))))[1]
  if( !is.na(stop_at)) body <- body[seq_len(stop_at-1), , drop=FALSE]
  
  names(body) <- make.unique(hdr[cols])
  rownames(body) <- NULL
  
  #Makes a column numeric
  body[] <- lapply(body,function(x){
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    filled <- !is_blank(x)
    if(any(filled) && mean(!is.na(num[filled])) >=0.5) num else x
  })
  as_tibble(body)
}
wavelengths<- c("405","630")

Frames<- setNames(lapply(wavelengths, function(w) extract_block(raw,w)), wavelengths)

for (n in wavelengths){
assign(paste0("df_", n, "nm"), Frames[[n]])
}

#Caculation Dataframes
id_col <- names(df_405nm)[1:2] #Setting the first column as the ID column, using the first dataset
value_cols <- setdiff(intersect(names(df_405nm)[sapply(df_405nm,is.numeric)],
                                names(df_630nm)[sapply(df_630nm,is.numeric)]),
id_col)

df_OD <- df_405nm
df_OD[value_cols] <- df_405nm[value_cols] - df_630nm[value_cols]

df_mOD <- df_OD
df_mOD[value_cols] <- df_OD[value_cols] * 1000


for (b in c("df_OD")) {
  
  df <- get(b)
  
  # Extract the last 3 columns safely
  blank_cols <- df[, (ncol(df) - 2):ncol(df)]
}

Blank_mean<-rowMeans(blank_cols)

df_mOD %>% 
  mutate("Average Blank" = Blank_mean)

df_BlankNorm<- df_OD

   for (i in 3:(ncol(df_OD)-3)) {
  df_BlankNorm[,i] <- df_OD[,i] -Blank_mean
}

#Grouping by letters
groups <- str_match(names(df_BlankNorm),"\\(([A-Z])\\d+\\)")[,2]
Letters <- unique(na.omit(groups))

df_group<- df_BlankNorm %>% 
  select(Reading,`avg. time [s]`) %>% 
  bind_cols(sapply(Letters,function(letter){
    cols<- names(df_BlankNorm)[!is.na(groups) & groups==letter]
    rowMeans(df_BlankNorm[,cols,drop=FALSE],na.rm=TRUE)
  }) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(Letters)) %>% 
    mutate(`avg. time [m]` =`avg. time [s]`/60)

```

# Analytic

names_to

```{r}
#Function to caculate each group:
calc_metrics <- function(t, y, window_end = 1800, buffer = 60, delta_cut = -10) {
  has_value <- !is.na(t) & !is.na(y)
  t <- t[has_value]
  y <- y[has_value]
  ord <- order(t)
  t <- t[ord] 
  y <- y[ord]
  
  #Finds the window, as well as max y index and baseline
  window<- t <= window_end
  y_min <- min(y[window])
  index_max<- which.max(y)
  y_max <- y[index_max]
  baseline<- y[1]
  
  #MA and T1
  MA <- y_max - y_min
  T1 <- round(t[index_max])
  
  #Tlag5
  fiveprc <- 0.05 * (baseline)
  thr   <- baseline +fiveprc
  i_lag <- which(y>=thr)[1]
  Tlag5 <- t[i_lag]
  y_Tlag5 <- y[i_lag]
  
  #Finds the window 
  time_window <- round(t[window])
  y_window    <- y[window]
  AUC <- sum(diff(time_window) * (head(y_window, -1) + tail(y_window, -1)) / 2)
  
  y_prev <- approx(t, y, xout = t - 60)$y #Searchs for prev y-point 60 seconds back
  delta  <- (y - y_prev) *1000 #Caculates the change in y
  search <- which(t >= T1 + buffer) #Applies a minute buffer
  search <- search[search > 1] #Searches after the buffer
  hit    <- search[which(delta[search - 1] < delta_cut & delta[search] >= delta_cut)][1] #Looks for when, the change after the search exceeds -10
  T2     <- if (is.na(hit)) NA_real_ else round(t[hit]) #Retrurns timepoint value
  y_T2 <- if (is.na(hit)) NA_real_ else y[hit]
  
  tibble(y_min, y_max, MA, T1, Tlag5, AUC, T2, T2_minus_T1 = T2 - T1,y_Tlag5,y_T2)
}


df_group_plt <- df_group %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols= all_of(Letters), names_to="Group",values_to="Group_Reading") %>% 
  filter(Group !="F")

df_analytics <- df_group_plt %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  summarise(calc_metrics(`avg. time [s]`, Group_Reading), .groups = "drop")

df_points<-bind_rows(
  df_analytics %>% transmute(Group, Point="T1",`avg. time [s]`=T1, Group_Reading=y_max),
  df_analytics %>% transmute(Group, Point="T2",`avg. time [s]`=T2, Group_Reading=y_T2),
  df_analytics %>% transmute(Group, Point="Tlag5",`avg. time [s]`=Tlag5, Group_Reading=y_Tlag5)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`avg. time [s]`))

#Plots
g<- ggplot(df_group_plt, aes(`avg. time [s]`, Group_Reading, color=Group))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_vline(data=filter(df_analytics, !is.na(T2)), aes(xintercept=T2, color=Group), linetype="dashed",show.legend = FALSE)+
  geom_point(data=df_points, aes(shape=Point),size=3)+
  scale_shape_manual(name="Point",values=c("Tlag5"=16, "T1"=17,"T2"=15))+
   coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4000))
  labs(x="Average Time (seconds)",y="Average Reading")

ggsave(paste0(Plots,"/Annotated Graph.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

#Function to caculate each group's statistics
calc_metrics <- function(t, y, window_end = 1800, buffer = 60, delta_cut = -10) {
  has_value <- !is.na(t) & !is.na(y)
  t <- t[has_value]
  y <- y[has_value]
  ord <- order(t)
  t <- t[ord] 
  y <- y[ord]
  
  #Finds the window, as well as max y index and baseline
  window<- t <= window_end
  y_min <- min(y[window])
  index_max<- which.max(y)
  y_max <- y[index_max]
  baseline<- y[1]
  
  #MA and T1
  MA <- y_max - y_min
  T1 <- round(t[index_max])
  
  #Tlag5
  fiveprc <- 0.05 * (baseline)
  thr   <- baseline +fiveprc
  i_lag <- which(y>=thr)[1]
  Tlag5 <- t[i_lag]
  y_Tlag5 <- y[i_lag]
  
  #Finds the window 
  time_window <- round(t[window])
  y_window    <- y[window]
  AUC <- sum(diff(time_window) * (head(y_window, -1) + tail(y_window, -1)) / 2)
  
  y_prev <- approx(t, y, xout = t - 60)$y #Searchs for prev y-point 60 seconds back
  delta  <- (y - y_prev) #Caculates the change in y
  search <- which(t >= T1 + buffer) #Applies a minute buffer
  search <- search[search > 1] #Searches after the buffer
  hit    <- search[which(delta[search - 1] < delta_cut & delta[search] >= delta_cut)][1] #Looks for when, the change after the search exceeds -10
  T2     <- if (is.na(hit)) NA_real_ else round(t[hit]) #Retrurns timepoint value
  y_T2 <- if (is.na(hit)) NA_real_ else y[hit]
  
  tibble(y_min, y_max, MA, T1, Tlag5, AUC, T2, T2_minus_T1 = T2 - T1,y_Tlag5,y_T2)
}
